purpose: Reconcile every M1 item assigned to M4 before defining new rules, without carrying current heuristic effects forward.

source_levels.meaning: Standard formula or verifiable meaning of a datum.
source_levels.cannot_authorize: predictive sign, threshold, weight or probability

source_levels.can_authorize: a mechanism stated with its assumptions

source_levels.meaning: Primary study with a comparable forward outcome.
source_levels.cannot_authorize: transfer across pairs, horizons or regimes

source_levels.meaning: Preregistered relation to TP, SL or expiry.

hard_gates: A data source validates meaning and availability, not prediction.
No current point, threshold or weight transfers automatically.
A P1 parent cannot influence P0 through probability block 28.
Definitions and hypotheses remain separate records.
No rule receives direct probability mass in M4.
Every target family must later name exact M3 data contracts.
Missing or stale data never becomes neutral evidence.
All pairs and horizons require the same formula and declared parameters.
Combinations are preregistered before empirical evaluation.

rows.current_formula: EMA_t = alpha*x_t + (1-alpha)*EMA_(t-1), alpha=2/(period+1)
rows.reason: A correctly initialized EMA may be a deterministic smoother. Its periods and predictive interpretation require separate rules.

rows.current_formula: if len(closes)<200: ema(closes, min(80,len(closes))) etiquetada ema_200
rows.reason: A shorter history must not be labelled EMA200. M5 must block insufficient history instead of synthesizing an equivalent value.

rows.current_formula: Media simple de true ranges recientes
rows.reason: The current simple-mean ATR variant is not the approved P0 horizon volatility scale. M4.2 will define that scale directly.

rows.current_formula: bullish/bearish/mixed por orden EMA9, EMA21 y EMA50
rows.reason: EMA ordering can describe smoothed price structure but cannot retain the current directional score or arbitrary timeframe weights.

rows.current_name: Detector interno de soportes y resistencias
rows.current_formula: Cluster de extremos recientes y distancia porcentual al nivel
rows.reason: The current clustering constants are internal. A deterministic level detector and barrier-distance contract must be defined first.

rows.current_formula: (buy_notional-sell_notional)/(buy+sell) sobre muestra reciente
rows.reason: A bounded Binance aggTrades window is trade-flow imbalance, not full cumulative volume delta. The last-500 sample is forbidden.

rows.current_formula: Confluencia, activacion, sweep, rechazo/ruptura y calidad de camino
rows.reason: Pending entry must be represented as a separate activation event under the M2 probability tree, never as an additive TP score.

rows.current_formula: EMA stacks ponderados; cortes +/-0.2 y +/-0.55; efecto +0.10/+0.05/-0.05/-0.09
rows.reason: The current points and timeframe weights have no admissible derivation.

rows.current_formula: Score EMA+precio/EMA+RSI; cortes +/-0.15 y +/-0.45; efecto +0.035/+0.015/-0.02/-0.04
rows.reason: A technical rating cannot enter P0 as an opaque aggregate. Only individually documented components may survive.

rows.current_formula: Long: +0.03 si price<=entry, si no -0.02; short simetrico
rows.reason: The discontinuous current adjustment is replaced by continuous log-distance geometry already required by M2.

rows.current_formula: Efectos 0.024/-0.028/-0.018 con multiplicador por horizonte
rows.reason: Regime is contextual state, not an automatic long/short bonus. Its estimator, persistence and transition rules require definition.

rows.current_formula: Ajuste actual 0 para favorable y negativo para contextos adversos
rows.reason: Fibonacci belongs to P1 block 4. Its presence in block 28 cannot bypass the priority gate or create a P0 probability adjustment.

rows.current_formula: Ajustes discretos de zona hasta +0.025/-0.035
rows.reason: Zone quality must affect an activation event, not add TP points.

rows.current_formula: Umbrales 1.12/0.88; efecto +/-0.02 por lado y derivatives_weight
rows.reason: The datum is viable, but fixed ratio thresholds and points are withdrawn pending an exact event window and normalization.

rows.current_formula: Umbral +/-0.12; efecto +/-0.018 por lado y micro_weight
rows.reason: This is not independent evidence from the taker-flow family.

rows.current_formula: OI change >=0.2 y signo precio 24h; efecto +/-0.02
rows.reason: OI is unsigned activity. Directional interpretation requires an explicit interaction with price and cannot retain current points.

rows.current_formula: 0.07 si risk_distance < max(range,ATR)*0.35
rows.reason: A barrier-to-volatility ratio is continuous plan geometry; fixed penalty bands are withdrawn.

rows.current_formula: 0.03 si spread_pct>0.04
rows.reason: Spread and depth affect executable price and costs. They do not directly alter market-path probability without a separate study.

rows.current_formula: 0.025 si abs(price_vs_ema21)>max(0.5,ATR*1.8)
rows.reason: Distance from a smoother must be volatility-normalized. Mean reversion or continuation remains an unproven project hypothesis.

rows.current_formula: 0.025 si long funding>0.03 o short funding<-0.03
rows.reason: Funding sign and magnitude are retained as state and cost inputs; the current directional penalty is withdrawn.

rows.current_formula: Thresholds internos de funding actual frente a media reciente
rows.reason: Relative funding needs interval-aware history and robust normalization; it is the same evidence family as current funding.

rows.current_formula: 0.025 si nivel queda antes de max(0.25,35% del reward)
rows.reason: Current points are withdrawn; only explicit level-to-barrier geometry remains.

rows.current_formula: Penalizacion discreta por estructura 4h/1d contraria y horizonte
rows.reason: Higher-timeframe evidence must be represented once through a declared hierarchy, not duplicated as trend and penalty.

rows.current_formula: 0.02 por RSI extremo y extension frente a EMA/ATR
rows.reason: The aggregate mixes P0 and deferred P1 signals and has no unique formula.

rows.current_formula: 0.025 si barrera<55% reward; 0.012 si <85%
rows.reason: This duplicates the level family and cannot contribute independently.

rows.current_formula: Penalizacion discreta por combinaciones de precio y OI
rows.reason: This duplicates the price-OI interaction and retains no separate points.

rows.current_formula: Cuenta contradicciones y aplica 0.018/0.032/0.045
rows.reason: Counting heterogeneous contradictions assumes equal and independent effects. M4.6 will define explicit interactions instead.

rows.current_formula: Suma de gates con floor agregado -0.16
rows.reason: The learning engine is paused and evidence from the old heuristic engine cannot define P0 rules or probability weights.

rows.current_formula: Aumenta range_probability por baja activacion pendiente
rows.reason: No-entry and expiry-after-entry remain separate outcomes; a range adjustment cannot merge their probability mass.

rows.current_formula: Ajuste agregado de rango; actualmente no activado en cohorte E1.4
rows.reason: Old retrospective calibration cannot set the new unresolved probability.
